```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(ggforce)   # demi-lunes (geom_arc_bar)
library(scales)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

# Ordre des sites
ordre_sites <- c("Del Sale", "Barcaghju", "Asciaghju", "Arje Vecchie", "Crovani")

# Palier de salinité à exclure (non numérique / hors traitement)
exclure_salinite <- c("Evol")
```

## 1. Import et harmonisation des données

### 1.1 Import des fichiers

```{r}
#| label: import-fichiers
Data_terrain_formate <- read_excel(here("Data", "Data_terrain_formate.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
Corse_Seedbank       <- read_excel(here("Data", "Corse_Seedbank_Data_simplifie.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
Data_salinity        <- read_excel(here("Data", "Data_salinity_corse.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
```

### 1.2 Fonctions de classement des espèces

```{r}
#| label: classer-genre
classer_genre <- function(nom_espece) {
  x <- str_to_lower(nom_espece)
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "althenia") & !str_detect(x, "/")            ~ "Althenia",
    str_detect(x, "ruppia")   & !str_detect(x, "/")             ~ "Ruppia",
    str_detect(x, "chara|tolypella|lamprothamnium|characeae")   ~ "Characeae",
    str_detect(x, "ranunculus")                                 ~ "Ranunculus",
    str_detect(x, "riella")                                     ~ "Riella",
    str_detect(x, "stuckenia")                                  ~ "Stuckenia",
    str_detect(x, "zannichellia")                               ~ "Zannichellia",
    TRUE                                                        ~ NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: classer-espece
classer_espece <- function(nom_espece) {
  x <- nom_espece |>
    str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
    str_squish()

  genre_detecte <- case_when(
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "althenia") & str_detect(x, "/") ~ NA_character_, # "Althenia/Ruppia" ambigu -> exclu
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "althenia")       ~ "Althenia",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "ruppia")         ~ "Ruppia",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "characeae")      ~ "Characeae",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "^chara\\b")      ~ "Chara",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "tolypella")      ~ "Tolypella",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "lamprothamnium") ~ "Lamprothamnium",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "ranunculus")     ~ "Ranunculus",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "riella")         ~ "Riella",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "stuckenia")      ~ "Stuckenia",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "zannichellia")   ~ "Zannichellia",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  epithete <- str_trim(str_remove(x, "^[A-Za-z]+\\s*"))
  epithete_valide <- !str_detect(str_to_lower(epithete), "^sp\\.?$|^spp\\.?$|^$")

  if_else(
    is.na(genre_detecte), NA_character_,
    if_else(epithete_valide, paste(genre_detecte, epithete), genre_detecte)
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: regrouper-espece-presence
regrouper_espece_presence <- function(espece) {
  case_when(
    espece %in% c("Althenia", "Althenia filiformis")     ~ "Althenia filiformis",
    espece %in% c("Ruppia", "Ruppia cirrhosa")            ~ "Ruppia cirrhosa",
    espece == "Ruppia maritima"                           ~ "Ruppia maritima",
    espece == "Ruppia drepanensis"                        ~ NA_character_,
    espece == "Chara"                                     ~ NA_character_,
    espece == "Chara aspera"                              ~ "Chara aspera",
    espece == "Chara bizarre"                             ~ "Chara sp.",
    espece == "Chara canescens"                           ~ "Chara canescens",
    espece == "Chara vulgaris"                            ~ "Chara vulgaris",
    espece == "Characeae"                                 ~ NA_character_,
    espece == "Lamprothamnium"                            ~ "Lamprothamnium",
    espece == "Ranunculus peltatus"                       ~ "Ranunculus peltatus",
    espece == "Ranunculus trichophyllus"                  ~ "Ranunculus trichophyllus",
    str_starts(espece, "Riella")                          ~ NA_character_,
    espece %in% c("Stuckenia", "Stuckenia pectinata")     ~ "Stuckenia pectinata",
    espece == "Tolypella"                                 ~ NA_character_,
    espece == "Tolypella glomerata"                       ~ "Tolypella glomerata",
    espece %in% c("Zannichellia", "Zannichellia palustris") ~ "Zannichellia palustris",
    TRUE ~ espece 
  )
}
```

### 1.3 Données terrain (% de recouvrement)

```{r}
#| label: import-terrain
terrain_brut <- Data_terrain_formate |>
  rename(Site = `Lagune`, Releve = `Relevé`) |>
  mutate(Site = str_trim(Site))
```

### 1.4 Données banque de graines

```{r}
#| label: import-seedbank

correspondance_lagune <- tibble(
  Lagune = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
  Site   = c("Crovani", "Barcaghju", "Arje Vecchie", "Del Sale", "Asciaghju")
)

seedbank_brut <- Corse_Seedbank |>
  select(-Site) |>                      
  mutate(Lagune = as.numeric(Lagune)) |>
  left_join(correspondance_lagune, by = "Lagune")

seedbank_long <- seedbank_brut |>
  mutate(Genre = classer_genre(Sp_identifiees)) |>
  filter(!is.na(Genre)) |>
  
  group_by(Site, Bac_Barquette, Genre) |>
  summarise(nb_individus = sum(Nmbr_nouv_indiv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

### 1.5 Données salinité (manip) — dernière date uniquement

```{r}
#| label: import-salinity
salinity_brut <- Data_salinity |>
  select(-Site) |>                      
  rename(Site = ID_LAG) |>             
  mutate(Site = str_trim(Site))


salinity_derniere_date <- salinity_brut |>
  filter(!Salinite %in% exclure_salinite) |>
  mutate(Salinite = as.numeric(Salinite)) |>
  group_by(Bac_Barquette) |>
  filter(Date == max(Date, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()
```

## 2. Présence/absence : terrain vs manip

```{r}
#| label: presence-manip-espece
terrain_espece_long <- terrain_brut |>
  pivot_longer(-c(Site, Releve), names_to = "espece_brute", values_to = "recouvrement") |>
  mutate(
    Espece = classer_espece(espece_brute),
    Espece = regrouper_espece_presence(Espece)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Espece)) |>
  group_by(Site, Releve, Espece) |>
  summarise(recouvrement = sum(recouvrement, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

terrain_presence_espece <- terrain_espece_long |>
  group_by(Site, Espece) |>
  summarise(present = any(recouvrement > 0), .groups = "drop")

salinity_espece_long <- salinity_derniere_date |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(Date, Obs, Bac.x, Barquette.x, Bac_Barquette, Salinite, Site, CodeBarquette),
    names_to = "espece_brute", values_to = "recouvrement"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Espece = classer_espece(espece_brute),
    Genre  = classer_genre(espece_brute),
    Espece = regrouper_espece_presence(Espece)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Espece))

salinity_presence_espece <- salinity_espece_long |>
  group_by(Site, Espece) |>
  summarise(present = any(recouvrement > 0), .groups = "drop")

# Banque de graines : Riella compté seulement si un échantillon a >= 10 individus
seedbank_presence_genre <- seedbank_long |>
  mutate(echantillon_valide = if_else(Genre == "Riella", nb_individus >= 10, nb_individus > 0)) |>
  group_by(Site, Genre) |>
  summarise(present = any(echantillon_valide), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(present)

# Renommage vers l'espèce fine seulement si une seule espèce en salinité (site x genre)
nomenclature_fine_site <- salinity_espece_long |>
  filter(recouvrement > 0, !is.na(Genre)) |>
  distinct(Site, Genre, Espece) |>
  group_by(Site, Genre) |>
  summarise(
    n_especes   = n_distinct(Espece),
    espece_fine = if_else(n_especes == 1, first(Espece), NA_character_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

seedbank_presence_espece <- seedbank_presence_genre |>
  left_join(nomenclature_fine_site, by = c("Site", "Genre")) |>
  mutate(
    Espece = if_else(!is.na(espece_fine), espece_fine, Genre),
    Espece = regrouper_espece_presence(Espece)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Espece)) |>
  select(Site, Espece, present)

# Manip = banque de graines OU salinité
manip_presence_espece <- bind_rows(salinity_presence_espece, seedbank_presence_espece) |>
  group_by(Site, Espece) |>
  summarise(present = any(present), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-presence-absence
#| fig-cap: "Presence/absence per species and site — field (left half) vs manipulation (right half: seed bank + salinity)"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 7

# Espèces, de gauche à droite
ordre_especes_presence <- c(
   "Ranunculus trichophyllus", 
   "Zannichellia palustris", 
  "Ranunculus peltatus",  
  "Chara vulgaris",   
  "Chara aspera",
  "Stuckenia pectinata",        
  "Chara canescens", 
  "Tolypella glomerata", 
   "Althenia filiformis", 
  "Ruppia maritima",           
  "Ruppia cirrhosa",            
  "Lamprothamnium"       
)

# Sites, de haut en bas
ordre_sites_presence <- c("Del Sale", "Barcaghju", "Arje Vecchie", "Asciaghju", "Crovani")


especes_dans_donnees <- unique(c(terrain_presence_espece$Espece, manip_presence_espece$Espece))

# Les espèces de la liste d'abord (dans l'ordre choisi), puis celles non listées à la fin
especes_presentes <- c(
  intersect(ordre_especes_presence, especes_dans_donnees),
  sort(setdiff(especes_dans_donnees, ordre_especes_presence))
)

presence_totale <- bind_rows(
  terrain_presence_espece |> mutate(Source = "Field"),
  manip_presence_espece   |> mutate(Source = "Manip")
) |>
  complete(Site = ordre_sites_presence, Espece = especes_presentes, Source,
           fill = list(present = FALSE)) |>
  mutate(
    Site   = factor(Site, levels = rev(ordre_sites_presence)),
    Espece = factor(Espece, levels = especes_presentes),
    x = as.numeric(Espece),
    y = as.numeric(Site),
    start = if_else(Source == "Field", pi, 0),
    end   = if_else(Source == "Field", 2 * pi, pi)
  )

ggplot(presence_totale) +
  geom_arc_bar(
    aes(x0 = x, y0 = y, r0 = 0, r = 0.42, start = start, end = end, fill = present),
    color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y - 0.42, yend = y + 0.42),
               color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "white"),
                     labels = c(`TRUE` = "Present", `FALSE` = "Absent"),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(especes_presentes), labels = especes_presentes,
                      position = "top", expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(ordre_sites_presence), labels = rev(ordre_sites_presence),
                      expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Sites",
       caption = "Left half = Field   |   Right half = Experimentation") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic", angle = 30, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
                                margin = margin(b = 2), size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold")
  )
```

## 3. Abondance terrain par espèce

```{r}
#| label: terrain-resume-espece
terrain_espece_long_abondance <- terrain_brut |>
  pivot_longer(-c(Site, Releve), names_to = "espece_brute", values_to = "recouvrement") |>
  mutate(
    Espece = classer_espece(espece_brute),
    Espece = if_else(Espece == "Ruppia", "Ruppia cirrhosa", Espece) 
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Espece)) |>
  group_by(Site, Releve, Espece) |>
  summarise(recouvrement = sum(recouvrement, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

terrain_resume_espece <- terrain_espece_long_abondance |>
  group_by(Site, Espece) |>
  summarise(
    moyenne = mean(recouvrement, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(recouvrement, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-abondance-terrain
#| fig-cap: "Pourcentage de recouvrement moyen (± SE) par espèce et par site — données terrain"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 9

# Ordre des panneaux : ligne 1 puis ligne 2 (5 par ligne)
ordre_panneaux <- c(
  "Ranunculus trichophyllus", "Zannichellia palustris", "Ranunculus peltatus",
  "Chara aspera", "Stuckenia pectinata",
  "Ruppia maritima", "Althenia filiformis", "Chara canescens",
  "Tolypella glomerata", "Ruppia cirrhosa"
)

# Ordre des sites de haut en bas pour ce graphique
ordre_sites_terrain <- c("Del Sale", "Barcaghju", "Arje Vecchie", "Asciaghju", "Crovani")

terrain_plot_df <- terrain_resume_espece |>
  filter(Espece %in% ordre_panneaux) |>
  mutate(
    Espece = factor(Espece, levels = ordre_panneaux),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = rev(ordre_sites_terrain))
  )

ggplot(terrain_plot_df, aes(x = moyenne, y = Site)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = pmax(moyenne - se, 0), xmax = moyenne + se),
                   color = "black", size = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~Espece, ncol = 5, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4),
                      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "% de recouvrement moyen ± SE", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```
